policy.actability_contract: skill actability group; bonuses excluded when use_only_actability
policy.count: positive; committed one unit at a time
policy.material_grade_contract: require_grade exact; upper_grade accepts greater or equal; -1 wildcard
policy.money_cost: base copper cost per committed unit
policy.product_grade_contract: use_grade fixes item_grade_id; otherwise main_grade then highest same-impl material

query_specs.autoequip_backpacks: SELECT ib.item_id FROM item_backpacks ib JOIN items i ON i.id=ib.item_id WHERE COALESCE(i.bind_id, 0) <> 3
query_specs.craft_effect_skills: SELECT DISTINCT se.skill_id FROM skill_effects se JOIN effects e ON e.id=se.effect_id WHERE e.actual_type='CraftEffect'
query_specs.crafts: SELECT id, cast_delay, skill_id, wi_id, milestone_id, req_doodad_id, actability_limit, recommend_level, visible_order, enable, products_pack_id, use_only_actability, craft_c_category_id, craft_d_category_id, orderable, cost FROM crafts ORDER BY id
query_specs.materials: SELECT id, craft_id, item_id, amount, main_grade, require_grade, upper_grade FROM craft_materials ORDER BY id
query_specs.native_rate_consumers: union of craft_line_components, craft_pack_crafts, item_recipes, items.craft_id and live DoodadFuncCraftStart rows
query_specs.products: SELECT id, craft_id, item_id, amount, rate, use_grade, item_grade_id FROM craft_products ORDER BY id
